ORIGIN: LOCOMOTIVE WORKS · 2013 CURRENT: COMCAST X1 · AI TECHNICAL LEAD

I started out fixing locomotives and ended up building software. Ten-plus years of shipping production code later, the habit never changed: open it up, learn every moving part, put it back together better than you found it. Today I'm a Principal Engineer and AI Technical Lead on Comcast's X1 platform, doing the customer-facing kind of engineering — embed with the teams feeling the pain, find the bottleneck, then ship AI-native workflows the whole company ends up boarding. Before that — smart TVs, robot safety controllers, Navy ships, my own startup, and a lot of bars with very good screens.

DEP DESTINATION / SERVICE STATUS

Mechanical Supervisor at the Altoona locomotive works — engines, wheelsets, traction motors. Taught myself to code on nights and built the shop's multi-tier production-line data system, plus Python CNC quality-control automation that erased eight hours a week of manual entry.

Engineering Technician V at NAVSEA SWRMC. Won a U.S. Navy innovation award for a MERN-stack data collection system that cut information-processing time and automated stakeholder reporting — my first software with users beyond a shop floor.

Founded a digital menu-board company in the San Diego years. Real-time boards a bar owner updates from any web-connected device — installed in five venues across two coasts.

Senior Analyst embedded with Life Science Cloud clients. Led discovery on document-upload pain points, then shipped the fixes and automation — client-reported issues down 84%, about $45k a year saved. Learned how software ships at enterprise scale — the process, the politics, and the parts worth keeping.

First stop at Comcast, via TekSystems: front-end team lead on X1's real-time telemetry product — the first software team I ran instead of a shop floor. Led three devs re-architecting the front-end around NgRx: 87% of tech debt resolved, feature delivery up 200%. Built a JS data-collection library scaled to 30 million devices, D3.js visualizations including a live per-market U.S. performance map, and Python blue/green monitoring to catch data drift.

Senior engineer and front-end team lead. Ran a team of five building the company's first client-facing product — an Angular web and Ionic mobile portal for managing their robotic safety controllers — the pivot from hardware company to platform-first software company. Built the core component library along the way: infinite-scroll and lazy-load directives, form wizards, async validators, all strict TypeScript and RxJS.

Principal Engineer and technical lead on the resident smart-TV app — the layer that bridges client-facing UI, third-party apps, physical TV hardware, and external APIs. Created the TV Toolkit, a one-click debugging and device-interface suite for devs and QA that cut onboarding and dev cycles 10%. Graduated the Comcast AI Academy — capstone shipped an XGBoost model that lifted acceptance of suggested next actions 30% in a customer-facing troubleshooting chat app.

Principal Engineer — AI Technical Lead, X1 Platform. I lead a squad embedded with teams across the X1 org: run discovery to find where development drags, then ship AI workflows the whole company adopts. On the board so far:

  • An agentic vulnerability-fix pipeline opening human-in-the-loop PRs — open security vulnerabilities down 80%
  • A spec-driven, AI-assisted migration of a mission-critical Java app — Java 8 to Java 25
  • An AI system that repairs broken tests, finds E2E coverage gaps, and generates new tests
  • An org-wide LLM onboarding tool — non-technical stakeholders explore the codebase and mock up features
